entries.earliest_caption: Tens of thousands of people have taken to the streets of Amsterdam as part of a massive "Red Line" protest, demanding that the Dutch government take stronger action against Israel's ongoing genocidal war in Gaza. According to the organisers, around 250,000 demonstrators participated in the protest on Sunday, making it one of the largest in the Netherlands in recent years, public broadcaster NOS reported. Dressed in red, protesters gathered at the Museumplein before marching through the capital to draw what they called a symbolic "red line" against the government's stance on Israel.
